```{r}
# ============================
# Entropy processing by genotype
# ============================

# Packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(writexl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
})

# === Base paths ===
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"
wb_path  <- file.path(base_dir, "all genotypes.xlsx")  # workbook name

# List sheets (genotypes) in the workbook
sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(wb_path)

# -------- Processing function per sheet/genotype --------
process_genotype <- function(sheet_name) {
  message("Processing genotype: ", sheet_name)

  # Output folder per genotype
  out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, sheet_name)
  if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Read sheet
  df <- read_excel(wb_path, sheet = sheet_name)

  # Standardize expected column names and types
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos_col] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent_col] <- "Entropy"
  }

  # Convert types and keep valid rows
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      # Supports decimal commas
      Entropy  = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("Sheet ", sheet_name, " has no valid data. Skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Classification into groups (single column: Group)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = case_when(
        Entropy == 0 ~ "Conserved",
        Entropy >= 0.1 & Entropy <= 0.5 ~ "Medium",
        Entropy > 0.5 ~ "High",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Conserved", "Medium", "High"))
    )

  # ===== Export a SINGLE Excel file ordered by Position ASC =====
  combined <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    arrange(Position) %>%                     # <- ascending order by Position
    select(Position, Entropy, Group)

  write_xlsx(
    combined,
    path = file.path(out_dir, paste0("entropy_by_group_", sheet_name, ".xlsx"))
  )

  # === Histogram (base R → PNG) ===
  png(file.path(out_dir, paste0("hist_entropy_hp", sheet_name, ".png")),
      width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
  op <- par(cex.main = 1.6, cex.lab = 1.4, cex.axis = 1.2, mgp = c(2.2, 0.7, 0))
  hist(df$Entropy,
       breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
       main   = paste("HPV", sheet_name),
       xlab   = "Shannon Entropy",
       col    = "lightblue",
       xlim   = c(0, 1),
       xaxt   = "n",
       freq   = TRUE)
  axis(side = 1, at = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))
  par(op); dev.off()

  # === Entropy profile (ggplot) ===
  p_profile <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Position, y = Entropy)) +
    geom_line(color = "coral", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(500)) +
    labs(title = paste("HPV", sheet_name),
         x = "Position", y = "Shannon Entropy") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 22),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("entropy_profile_hp", sheet_name, ".png")),
         plot = p_profile, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  # === Bar chart by group ===
  group_count <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    count(Group) %>%
    mutate(
      Range = case_when(
        Group == "Conserved" ~ "Entropy = 0",
        Group == "Medium"    ~ "Entropy 0.1 - 0.5",
        Group == "High"      ~ "Entropy > 0.5"
      ),
      Label = paste0(Group, "\n(", Range, ")"),
      Label = factor(Label, levels = Label)
    )

  p_bar <- ggplot(group_count, aes(x = Label, y = n, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Conserved" = "#66c2a5",
                                 "Medium"    = "#fc8d62",
                                 "High"      = "#8da0cb")) +
    labs(title = paste("Classification of positions based on entropy (HPV", sheet_name, ")"),
         x = NULL, y = "Number of positions") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
  ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("entropy_groups_bar_hp", sheet_name, ".png")),
         plot = p_bar, width = 6.5, height = 4.2, dpi = 300)

  # === Summary statistics + counts (Excel) ===
  entropy_summary <- as.data.frame(t(summary(df$Entropy))); rownames(entropy_summary) <- NULL
  group_counts_export <- as.data.frame(table(df$Group)); colnames(group_counts_export) <- c("Group", "Count")

  write_xlsx(
    list("Entropy_Summary" = entropy_summary,
         "Group_Counts"    = group_counts_export),
    path = file.path(out_dir, paste0("entropy_summary_and_counts_", sheet_name, ".xlsx"))
  )

  # Return summary for master table
  tibble(
    Genotype       = sheet_name,
    n_positions    = nrow(df),
    pct_conserved  = mean(df$Entropy == 0) * 100,
    pct_high       = mean(df$Entropy > 0.5) * 100,
    entropy_median = median(df$Entropy),
    entropy_IQR    = IQR(df$Entropy),
    entropy_max    = max(df$Entropy)
  )
}

# -------- Run for all sheets and export master summary --------
master_summary <- map_dfr(
  sheets,
  ~tryCatch(process_genotype(.x), error = function(e) { warning(e); NULL })
)

if (!is.null(master_summary) && nrow(master_summary) > 0) {
  write_xlsx(master_summary, file.path(base_dir, "master_summary_all_genotypes.xlsx"))
}

message("Done! Processed genotypes: ", paste(sheets, collapse = ", "))

```

```{r}
# install.packages("magick") # if you don't have it installed
library(magick)

# Base folder containing the genotype subdirectories 16, 18, 31, ..., 156
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"

# Histogram files generated: hist_entropy_hpX.png
files_all <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = "^hist_entropy_hp.*\\.png$",
                        recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

# Desired genotype order (adjust if you add/remove sheets)
order_sheets <- c("16","18","31","33","35","52","56","58",
                  "59","66","67","68","73","82","87","156")

# Reorder files according to the order above
ordered_files <- unlist(lapply(order_sheets, function(s){
  # search for a file ending in hp<s>.png within any subfolder
  idx <- grepl(paste0("hist_entropy_hp", s, "\\.png$"), files_all)
  files_all[idx]
}))

# Filter out NAs (in case some genotype does not have an image yet)
ordered_files <- ordered_files[!is.na(ordered_files)]

stopifnot(length(ordered_files) > 0)

# Read images
imgs <- image_read(ordered_files)

# Normalize size so all panels match (adjust width/height as needed)
# - If you specify only width ("1400"), height is preserved proportionally
imgs <- image_scale(imgs, "1400")

# Grid parameters
ncol <- 4  # number of columns in the mosaic (you can use 3, 4, or 5)
# Split into rows
rows <- split(seq_along(imgs), ceiling(seq_along(imgs) / ncol))

# Append within each row and then stack rows
row_imgs <- lapply(rows, function(ix) image_append(imgs[ix], stack = FALSE))
mosaic   <- image_append(image_join(row_imgs), stack = TRUE)

# (Optional) add a soft border
mosaic <- image_border(mosaic, color = "white", geometry = "10x10")

# Export final image (PNG)
out_png  <- file.path(base_dir, "Todos_hist_entropy_grid.png")
image_write(mosaic, out_png, format = "png")

# (Optional) also export as TIFF 600 dpi (often recommended by journals)
out_tif  <- file.path(base_dir, "Todos_hist_entropy_grid.tiff")
image_write(mosaic, out_tif, format = "tiff", density = "600x600")
```

```{r}
# ============================
# Add 'Gen' column to entropy_by_group_* without an external file
# ============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(writexl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
})

# ---- Base path where folders 16,18,31,... are located ----
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) COORDINATE TABLE (EDIT YOUR RANGES HERE)
#    - Genotype column: "16","18","31","33","35","52","56","58","59","66","67","68","73","82","87","156"
#    - Gene columns: E1, E2, E4, E5, E6, E7, L1, L2
#    - Accepts one OR multiple ranges per cell (separated by ; or ,), e.g. "879-2813; 2900-3000"
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
gene_coords <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Genotipo, ~E1,          ~E2,          ~E4,          ~E5,          ~E6,        ~E7,        ~L1,         ~L2,
  "16",      "865-2814",   "2756-3853",  "865-3620",   "3850-4101",  "104-559",  "562-858",  "5639-7156", "4237-5658",
  "18",      "914-2887",   "2817-3914",  "912-3684",   "3936-4157",  "105-581",  "590-907",  "5631-7123", "4244-5632",
  "31",      "862-2751",   "2693-3811",  "862-3578",   "3816-4070",  "108-557",  "560-856",  "5552-7066", "4171-5571",
  "33",      "879-2813",   "2749-3810",  "879-3577",   "3854-4081",  "109-558",  "573-866",  "5594-7093", "4210-5613",
  "35",      "868-2781",   "2717-3817",  "868-3319",   "3814-4065",  "110-559",  "562-861",  "5601-7109", "4211-5620",
  "58",      "883-2817",   "2753-3829",  "883-3605",   "3892-4122",  "110-559",  "574-870",  "5643-7139", "4244-5662",
  "59",      "872-2806",   "2748-3848",  "872-3615",   "3908-4129",  "55-537",   "542-865",  "5606-7132", "4231-5625",
  "66",      "895-2789",   "2729-3838",  "895-3605",   "N.A",        "102-569",  "572-889",  "5647-7158", "4272-5666",
  "67",      "875-2785",   "2721-3827",  "875-3591",   "3900-4121",  "102-551",  "563-862",  "5616-7118", "4238-5635",
  "68",      "823-2745",   "2687-3784",  "823-3551",   "3830-4051",  "1-477",    "484-816",  "5488-7005", "4098-5507",
  "73",      "850-2802",   "2744-3793",  "850-3560",   "3813-4037",  "102-548",  "550-843",  "5494-7005", "4083-5510",
  "82",      "876-2804",   "2746-3825",  "876-3601",   "N.A",        "102-557",  "565-867",  "5570-7081", "4168-5589",
  "87",      "819-2771",   "2713-3840",  "819-3607",   "4172-4315",  "105-551",  "527-817",  "5756-7270", "4360-5778",
  "156",     "805-2631",   "2567-3766",  "805-3530",   "N.A",        "106-528",  "525-818",  "5360-6889", "3775-5349"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------

# 2) Prepare coordinates (wide -> long), clean and expand multiple ranges
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
coords_long <- gene_coords %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~trimws(as.character(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Genotipo, names_to = "Gen", values_to = "range") %>%
  filter(!is.na(range), range != "") %>%
  mutate(range = gsub("\\s+", "", range)) %>%
  separate_rows(range, sep = "[;,]") %>%
  filter(range != "", !range %in% c("0","0-0","0 0")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Allows formats like "102-551" (OK)
    start = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("-.*$", "", range))),
    end   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^.*-", "", range)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end >= start) %>%
  transmute(Genotype = Genotipo, Gen, start, end)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Priority order in case of overlaps (edit if you want a different rule)
#    If a Position falls into multiple genes, the earliest in this list wins
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
gene_priority <- c("E6","E7","E1","E2","E4","E5","L2","L1")
coords_long$Gen <- factor(coords_long$Gen, levels = gene_priority)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Annotate each entropy_by_group_* file in all genotype folders
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
genotype_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

annotate_one_genotype <- function(gdir) {
  gname <- basename(gdir)

  # input file: entropy_by_group_<gname>.xlsx (or similar)
  f <- list.files(gdir, pattern = "^entropy_by_group_.*\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) == 0) {
    message("⚠ No entropy_by_group_*.xlsx found in: ", gdir)
    return(NULL)
  }

  df <- readxl::read_excel(f[1])
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

  # standardize expected column names
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos_col] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent_col] <- "Entropy"
  }
  if (!"Group" %in% names(df)) {
    grp_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^group")]
    if (length(grp_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == grp_col] <- "Group"
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE))),
      Group    = as.character(Group)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy)) %>%
    arrange(Position)

  # coordinates for the current genotype
  cg <- coords_long %>% filter(Genotype == gname)
  if (nrow(cg) == 0) {
    message("⚠ No coordinates found for genotype ", gname, " (in the embedded table). Gen will be set to NA.")
    df$Gen <- NA_character_
  } else {
    # priority assignment: iterate in gene_priority order
    df$Gen <- NA_character_
    cg <- cg %>% arrange(Gen)  # respects factor order (priority)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(cg))) {
      idx <- df$Position >= cg$start[i] & df$Position <= cg$end[i]
      df$Gen[idx] <- as.character(cg$Gen[i])
    }
  }

  # If you prefer to label out-of-range as "Intergenic", uncomment:
  # df$Gen[is.na(df$Gen)] <- "Intergenic"

  # order and refactor Group
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Conserved","Medium","High"))) %>%
    arrange(Position)

  # output
  out_file <- file.path(gdir, paste0("entropy_by_group_", gname, "_with_gen.xlsx"))
  writexl::write_xlsx(df, out_file)
  message("✔ Saved: ", out_file)
  invisible(df)
}

# Run
annotated <- purrr::map(genotype_dirs, ~tryCatch(annotate_one_genotype(.x),
                                                 error = function(e){ warning(e); NULL }))

```



```{r}
# --- A) Setup & bulk read ---
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(writexl); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr);  library(stringr); library(tidyr);  library(zoo)
})

# Base path (your "Todos" folder)
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"
fig_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "Global", "figures")
tab_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "Global", "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Detect genotype subfolders and *_with_gen.xlsx files
genotype_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

read_with_gen <- function(gdir){
  g <- basename(gdir)
  f <- list.files(gdir, pattern = "_with_gen\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f)==0) return(NULL)
  df <- read_excel(f[1])
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

  # Standardize expected column names
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos)==1) names(df)[names(df)==pos] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent)==1) names(df)[names(df)==ent] <- "Entropy"
  }
  if (!"Group" %in% names(df)) {
    grp <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^group")]
    if (length(grp)==1) names(df)[names(df)==grp] <- "Group"
  }
  stopifnot("Gen" %in% names(df))

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Genotype = g,
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Entropy)),
      Group    = factor(as.character(Group), levels = c("Conserved","Medium","High")),
      Gen      = as.character(Gen)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy)) %>%
    arrange(Position)
}

ent_all <- map(genotype_dirs, read_with_gen) %>% compact() %>% bind_rows()
stopifnot(nrow(ent_all) > 0)
ent_all$Genotype <- factor(ent_all$Genotype, levels = sort(unique(ent_all$Genotype)))
```

```{r}
  geom_line() +
```

```{r}
# --- F) High-entropy continuous blocks ---
high_blocks <- ent_all %>%
  filter(Group=="High") %>%
  arrange(Genotype, Position) %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  mutate(d = c(NA, diff(Position)),
         grp = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(d) | d!=1, 1, 0))) %>%
  group_by(Genotype, grp) %>%
  summarise(start=min(Position), end=max(Position),
            len=end-start+1, peak=max(Entropy),
            .groups="drop")
writexl::write_xlsx(high_blocks, file.path(tab_dir,"high_blocks_all.xlsx"))

p_len <- ggplot(high_blocks, aes(len)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30) +
  labs(title="Length distribution of high-entropy blocks (>0.5)",
       x="Block length (bp)", y="Count") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir,"high_blocks_length_hist.png"), p_len, width=7.5, height=5.5, dpi=300)
```

```{r}
# --- H) Fisher enrichment of High by Gene (per genotype) ---
fisher_results <- ent_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gen) & Gen!="") %>%
  mutate(isHigh = Group=="High") %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Gen) %>%
  summarise(High = sum(isHigh), NonHigh = sum(!isHigh), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  mutate(
    totalHigh      = sum(High),
    totalNonHigh   = sum(NonHigh),
    High_other     = totalHigh - High,
    NonHigh_other  = totalNonHigh - NonHigh
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_value = fisher.test(matrix(c(High, NonHigh, High_other, NonHigh_other), nrow=2))$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method="BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Gene-level metrics FOR EACH GENOTYPE (no plots)
# Reads:  .../Todos/<genotype>/entropy_by_group_<genotype>_with_gen.xlsx
# Writes:
#   - .../Todos/<genotype>/metrics_by_gene_HP<genotype>.xlsx
#   - .../Todos/master_metrics_by_gene_all_genotypes.xlsx
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(stringr); library(writexl)
})

# -------- PATHS --------
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"  # <- NOTE: 'Todo' (singular)

# Optional gene order in tables
gene_order <- c("E1","E2","E4","E5","E6","E7","L1","L2")

# -------- Function: read and clean one genotype --------
read_genotype_df <- function(gdir) {
  gt <- basename(gdir)  # folder name = genotype (e.g., "58")

  # 1) Exact match: entropy_by_group_<genotype>_with_gen.xlsx
  exact_file <- file.path(gdir, sprintf("entropy_by_group_%s_with_gen.xlsx", gt))
  if (file.exists(exact_file)) {
    f_path <- exact_file
  } else {
    # 2) Fallback: any *_with_gen.xlsx file inside the folder
    cand <- list.files(gdir, pattern = "_with_gen\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(cand) == 0) return(NULL)
    # If multiple, prioritize the one containing the genotype in the filename
    idx <- which(stringr::str_detect(basename(cand), paste0("\\b", gt, "\\b")))
    f_path <- if (length(idx) >= 1) cand[idx[1]] else cand[1]
  }

  df <- readxl::read_excel(f_path)
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

  # Standardize expected column names
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent] <- "Entropy"
  }
  if (!"Gen" %in% names(df)) stop("Missing 'Gen' column in: ", f_path)

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = gt,
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE))),
      Gen      = as.character(Gen)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy), !is.na(Gen), Gen != "") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Position)
}

# -------- Function: gene-level metrics for one genotype DF --------
summarise_metrics_by_gene <- function(df_one_gt) {
  # If Group does not exist, compute it (for %medium/%high/%conserved)
  if (!"Group" %in% names(df_one_gt)) {
    df_one_gt <- df_one_gt %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Group = dplyr::case_when(
          Entropy == 0 ~ "Conserved",
          Entropy >= 0.1 & Entropy <= 0.5 ~ "Medium",
          Entropy > 0.5 ~ "High",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )
  }

  out <- df_one_gt %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Gen) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_positions     = dplyr::n(),
      mean_entropy    = mean(Entropy),
      median_entropy  = median(Entropy),
      sd_entropy      = sd(Entropy),
      IQR_entropy     = IQR(Entropy),
      MAD_entropy     = mad(Entropy, constant = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      q05             = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Entropy, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),
      q25             = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Entropy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
      q75             = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Entropy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
      q95             = as.numeric(stats::quantile(Entropy, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),
      min_entropy     = min(Entropy),
      max_entropy     = max(Entropy),
      pct_conserved   = mean(Entropy == 0) * 100,
      pct_medium      = mean(Entropy >= 0.1 & Entropy <= 0.5) * 100,
      pct_high        = mean(Entropy > 0.5) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      entropy_cv         = dplyr::if_else(mean_entropy > 0, sd_entropy / mean_entropy, NA_real_),
      conservation_index = 1 - mean_entropy
    )

  # Sort genes if applicable
  genes_present <- intersect(gene_order, unique(out$Gen))
  if (length(genes_present) > 0) {
    out <- out %>% dplyr::mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = genes_present)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Gen)
  } else {
    out <- out %>% dplyr::arrange(Gen)
  }

  out
}

# --------- Loop through ALL genotype folders ----------
genotype_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

master_tbl <- list()

for (gdir in genotype_dirs) {
  # Skip base folder if list.dirs returns it as well
  if (normalizePath(gdir) == normalizePath(base_dir)) next

  df_gt <- try(read_genotype_df(gdir), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(df_gt, "try-error") || is.null(df_gt) || nrow(df_gt) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", basename(gdir), " (no valid data or no _with_gen file).")
    next
  }
  gt <- unique(df_gt$Genotype)[1]

  # Compute gene-level metrics
  met_gt <- summarise_metrics_by_gene(df_gt)
  master_tbl[[gt]] <- met_gt

  # Export per genotype
  out_path <- file.path(gdir, sprintf("metrics_by_gene_HP%s.xlsx", gt))
  writexl::write_xlsx(met_gt, out_path)
  message("✔ Saved: ", out_path)
}

# --------- Export combined master table ----------
if (length(master_tbl) > 0) {
  master_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(master_tbl)
  writexl::write_xlsx(master_df,
                      file.path(base_dir, "master_metrics_by_gene_all_genotypes.xlsx"))
  message("✔ Master: ", file.path(base_dir, "master_metrics_by_gene_all_genotypes.xlsx"))
} else {
  message("No master file generated: no valid genotypes found.")
}

```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# Variability by gene and by genotype (intra-genotype)
# Reads: .../Todos/<genotype>/entropy_by_group_<genotype>_with_gen.xlsx
# Saves tables and figures inside each genotype folder
# ======================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr);  library(stringr); library(writexl)
})

# ---------- Paths ----------
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"

# Optional gene order in figures (uses only genes that are present)
gene_order <- c("E1","E2","E4","E5","E6","E7","L1","L2")

# ---------- Safe read function ----------
read_with_gen <- function(gdir){
  g <- basename(gdir)
  f <- list.files(gdir, pattern = "_with_gen\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) == 0) return(NULL)

  df <- readxl::read_excel(f[1])
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

  # Standardize expected column names
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent] <- "Entropy"
  }
  if (!"Gen" %in% names(df)) stop("Missing 'Gen' column in: ", f[1])

  # If Group does not exist, compute it so we can measure %High and %Conserved
  if (!"Group" %in% names(df)) {
    df$Group <- NA_character_
    df$Group[df$Entropy == 0]                       <- "Conserved"
    df$Group[df$Entropy >= 0.1 & df$Entropy <= 0.5] <- "Medium"
    df$Group[df$Entropy > 0.5]                      <- "High"
  }

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = g,
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Entropy)),
      Gen      = as.character(Gen),
      Group    = factor(Group, levels = c("Conserved","Medium","High"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy), !is.na(Gen), Gen != "") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Position)
}

# ---------- Process ALL genotypes ----------
genotype_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

purrr::walk(genotype_dirs, function(gdir){

  df <- read_with_gen(gdir)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", basename(gdir), " (no data).")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  gt <- unique(df$Genotype)[1]

  # Output subfolder
  fig_dir <- file.path(gdir, "figures_intra_variability")
  dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # ---- Summary by GENE ----
  gene_summary <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gen) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n              = dplyr::n(),
      mean_entropy   = mean(Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_entropy = median(Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR_entropy    = IQR(Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_high       = mean(Group == "High", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_conserved  = mean(Group == "Conserved", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Ordering and factors
  genes_present <- intersect(gene_order, sort(unique(gene_summary$Gen)))
  if (length(genes_present) == 0) genes_present <- sort(unique(gene_summary$Gen))
  gene_summary$Gen <- factor(gene_summary$Gen, levels = genes_present)

  # Export summary table
  writexl::write_xlsx(gene_summary, file.path(gdir, sprintf("intra_gene_variability_summary_%s.xlsx", gt)))

  # ---- 1) Bar plot: mean entropy (0–1) by gene (sorted) ----
  p_mean <- gene_summary %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_entropy)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = Gen)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Gen, y = mean_entropy)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#4C78A8") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(mean_entropy, 3)), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(0.02, max(gene_summary$mean_entropy, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.12))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Mean Shannon entropy by gene — HPV", gt),
         x = "Gene", y = "Mean entropy (0–1)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("bar_mean_entropy_by_gene_HP%s.png", gt)),
         p_mean, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  # ---- 2) Bar plot: %High (>0.5) by gene (sorted) ----
  p_high <- gene_summary %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(pct_high)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = Gen)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Gen, y = pct_high)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#F58518") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = paste0(round(pct_high,1), "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(5, max(gene_summary$pct_high, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.12))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("% High entropy (>0.5) by gene — HPV", gt),
         x = "Gene", y = "% of positions (High)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("bar_pct_high_by_gene_HP%s.png", gt)),
         p_high, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  # ---- 3) Violin + boxplot: entropy distribution by gene ----
  p_violin <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gen %in% levels(gene_summary$Gen)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = levels(gene_summary$Gen))) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Gen, y = Entropy)) +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Entropy distribution by gene — HPV", gt),
         x = "Gene", y = "Shannon Entropy (0–1)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, sprintf("violin_entropy_by_gene_HP%s.png", gt)),
         p_violin, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)

  # ---- Console message: top/bottom by mean entropy ----
  top_gene <- gene_summary %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_entropy)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% dplyr::pull(Gen)
  low_gene <- gene_summary %>% dplyr::arrange(mean_entropy)              %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% dplyr::pull(Gen)
  message(sprintf("HPV %s -> Most variable (mean): %s | Most conserved (mean): %s", gt, top_gene, low_gene))
})



```


```{r}
# ============================
# Assign "Gen" by MSA column across genotypes
# using your entropy_by_group_<genotype>_with_gen.xlsx files
# and the MSA: HPV_Full_Aligned.fasta / HPV_Full_Aligned.fa
# ============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl);  library(writexl)
  library(dplyr);   library(tidyr);  library(purrr)
  library(stringr); library(ggplot2)
  library(Biostrings)   # IMPORTANT: for Biostrings::readDNAStringSet and Biostrings::width
})

# ---- Paths ----
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"

# Automatically locate FASTA (accepts .fasta or .fa)
fasta_candidates <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = "^HPV_Full_Aligned\\.(fa|fasta)$",
                               full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(fasta_candidates) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find FASTA file 'HPV_Full_Aligned.fasta' or 'HPV_Full_Aligned.fa' in: ", base_dir)
}
msa_fa <- fasta_candidates[1]
message("Using FASTA: ", msa_fa)

# Outputs
out_tab  <- file.path(base_dir, "Global", "tables",  "msa_gene_annotation.xlsx")
out_fig  <- file.path(base_dir, "Global", "figures", "msa_gene_annotation.png")
dir.create(dirname(out_tab), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(out_fig), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- 1) Read per-genotype with_gen files and infer gene ranges ----
genotype_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

read_with_gen <- function(gdir){
  g <- basename(gdir)
  f <- list.files(gdir, pattern = "_with_gen\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- readxl::read_excel(f[1])
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
  # standardize columns
  if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
    pos <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
    if (length(pos) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos] <- "Position"
  }
  if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
    ent <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
    if (length(ent) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent] <- "Entropy"
  }
  if (!"Gen" %in% names(df)) stop("Missing 'Gen' column in: ", f[1])

  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = g,
      Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
      Gen      = as.character(Gen)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Gen), Gen != "") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Position)
}

ent_all <- purrr::map(genotype_dirs, read_with_gen) %>% purrr::compact() %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
stopifnot(nrow(ent_all) > 0)

# RANGES per gene/genotype (min–max of positions labeled with that Gene)
gene_ranges <- ent_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Gen) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(start = min(Position), end = max(Position), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Genotype, start)

# ---- 2) Read MSA and build mappings column<->genome position per genotype ----
msa <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(msa_fa)

# Try to match FASTA names to folders (e.g., "16", "18", ...)
msa_names <- names(msa)

# If FASTA has names like "HPV16_consensus", extract numeric part
normalize_gt <- function(x){
  dig <- stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+")
  ifelse(!is.na(dig), dig, x)
}

folders      <- basename(genotype_dirs)
folders_norm <- normalize_gt(folders)
msa_norm     <- normalize_gt(msa_names)

# Keep only sequences present in both
keep <- msa_norm %in% folders_norm
if (!any(keep)) {
  stop("FASTA sequence names do not match genotype folders (not even by numeric part). ",
       "Rename the FASTA sequences or adjust normalize_gt().")
}
msa       <- msa[keep]
msa_names <- names(msa)
msa_norm  <- normalize_gt(msa_names)

# Reorder MSA to follow folder order if desired
ord <- match(sort(unique(folders_norm)), msa_norm)
ord <- ord[!is.na(ord)]
msa <- msa[ord]
msa_names <- names(msa)
msa_norm  <- normalize_gt(msa_names)

# Map: MSA name -> real folder name (first match)
norm_to_folder <- setNames(folders[match(msa_norm, folders_norm)], msa_names)

# Build maps: MSA column -> genome position, and genome position -> MSA column
build_maps <- function(s) {
  # s is an aligned DNAString (with '-' as gaps)
  chars <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(s), "", fixed = TRUE))
  ncol  <- length(chars)
  col_to_pos <- rep(NA_integer_, ncol)
  pos_to_col <- integer(0)
  pos <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(ncol)) {
    if (chars[i] == "-") {
      col_to_pos[i] <- NA_integer_
    } else {
      pos <- pos + 1L
      col_to_pos[i] <- pos
      if (length(pos_to_col) < pos) pos_to_col[pos] <- i
    }
  }
  list(col_to_pos = col_to_pos, pos_to_col = pos_to_col)
}

maps <- purrr::map(msa, build_maps)
# MSA length (use Biostrings::width to avoid name conflicts)
aln_len <- as.integer(Biostrings::width(msa)[1])

# Name each map with the corresponding real folder name
names(maps) <- norm_to_folder[names(maps)]

# ---- 3) Project each genotype's gene ranges to MSA columns ----
proj_ranges <- purrr::pmap_dfr(gene_ranges, function(Genotype, Gen, start, end) {
  m <- maps[[Genotype]]
  if (is.null(m)) {
    return(tibble(Genotype = Genotype, Gen = Gen, col_start = NA_integer_, col_end = NA_integer_))
  }
  cs <- if (start <= length(m$pos_to_col)) m$pos_to_col[start] else NA_integer_
  ce <- if (end   <= length(m$pos_to_col)) m$pos_to_col[end]   else NA_integer_
  tibble(Genotype = Genotype, Gen = Gen, col_start = cs, col_end = ce)
}) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(col_start), !is.na(col_end)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    col_start = pmin(col_start, col_end),
    col_end   = pmax(col_start, col_end)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Genotype, col_start)

# ---- 4) Voting per MSA column to assign a consensus Gene label ----
# For each genotype: vector (length = aln_len) with Gene label per MSA column
make_gene_vector <- function(gt){
  gv <- rep(NA_character_, aln_len)
  rgs <- proj_ranges %>% dplyr::filter(Genotype == gt)
  if (nrow(rgs) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rgs))) {
      gv[rgs$col_start[i]:rgs$col_end[i]] <- rgs$Gen[i]
    }
  }
  gv
}
gene_vectors <- setNames(lapply(unique(gene_ranges$Genotype), make_gene_vector),
                         unique(gene_ranges$Genotype))

# Matrix (rows = MSA columns; cols = genotypes) with gene labels
mat_gen <- do.call(cbind, gene_vectors)
colnames(mat_gen) <- names(gene_vectors)

# Voting rules
gene_priority <- c("E6","E7","E1","E2","E4","E5","L2","L1")
vote_min_frac <- 0.60  # require ≥60% agreement among annotated genotypes

assign_column_gene <- function(labels_charvec) {
  labs <- labels_charvec[!is.na(labels_charvec) & labels_charvec != ""]
  if (length(labs) == 0) return(c(Gene = "Unannotated", support = 0, n = 0))
  tb <- sort(table(labs), decreasing = TRUE)
  top <- names(tb)[1]
  support <- as.integer(tb[1])
  n <- length(labs)

  # If tie, break using predefined priority
  if (length(tb) > 1 && tb[1] == tb[2]) {
    tied <- names(tb)[tb == tb[1]]
    ord  <- match(tied, gene_priority)
    top  <- tied[order(ord)][1]
  }

  frac <- support / n
  if (frac < vote_min_frac) {
    return(c(Gene = "Ambiguous", support = support, n = n))
  } else {
    return(c(Gene = top,        support = support, n = n))
  }
}

res_list <- lapply(seq_len(aln_len), function(cix){
  labs <- mat_gen[cix, , drop = TRUE]
  out  <- assign_column_gene(labs)
  tibble(aln_col = cix,
         Gene    = out[["Gene"]],
         support = as.integer(out[["support"]]),
         n_votes = as.integer(out[["n"]]))
})
msa_gene_annot <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)

# ---- 5) Export per-column MSA annotation ----
writexl::write_xlsx(msa_gene_annot, out_tab)
message("✔ MSA per-column annotation exported to: ", out_tab)

# ---- 6) Figure: gene “blocks” along the MSA ----
msa_gene_annot <- msa_gene_annot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene = factor(Gene,
                              levels = c("E6","E7","E1","E2","E4","E5","L2","L1","Ambiguous","Unannotated")))

runlen <- rle(as.character(msa_gene_annot$Gene))
ends   <- cumsum(runlen$lengths)
starts <- c(1, head(ends, -1) + 1)
plot_df <- tibble(Gene = runlen$values, start = starts, end = ends) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene != "Unannotated")  # optional: hide empty segments

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = Gene)) +
  geom_rect() +
  labs(title = "Gene consensus along MSA columns",
       x = "MSA column", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(out_fig, p, width = 12, height = 2.8, dpi = 300)
message("✔ Figure exported to: ", out_fig)

```

```{r}
# ============================
# Group classification for Entropy_consensus (inter-genotype consensus)
# Reads: C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos/Consensos/Entropy_consensus.(xlsx|csv)
# Writes:
#   - Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx
#   - Entropy_consensus_group_summary.xlsx
# ============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(writexl)
})

# --- Paths ---
cons_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos/Consensos"

# Automatically find the file (xlsx or csv)
cand <- list.files(cons_dir, pattern = "^Entropy_consensus\\.(xlsx|csv)$",
                   full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
if (length(cand) == 0) stop("Could not find 'Entropy_consensus.xlsx' or 'Entropy_consensus.csv' in: ", cons_dir)
in_path <- cand[1]
message("Reading: ", in_path)

# --- Robust read ---
if (grepl("\\.xlsx$", in_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  df <- read_excel(in_path)
} else {
  df <- read.csv(in_path, check.names = FALSE)
}

# --- Standardize expected names and types ---
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

# Ensure 'Position' and 'Entropy' columns exist
if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
  pos_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
  if (length(pos_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == pos_col] <- "Position"
}
if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
  ent_col <- names(df)[str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
  if (length(ent_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == ent_col] <- "Entropy"
}

# Convert to numeric (supports decimal commas)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
    Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy)) %>%
  arrange(Position)

# --- Group classification (your rules) ---
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Entropy == 0 ~ "Conserved",
      Entropy >= 0.1 & Entropy <= 0.5 ~ "Medium",
      Entropy > 0.5 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Conserved", "Medium", "High"))
  )

# --- Export results ---
out_table <- file.path(cons_dir, "Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx")
write_xlsx(df, out_table)
message("✔ File with groups: ", out_table)

# (Optional) Count summary + statistics
group_counts <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  count(Group, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(100 * Count / sum(Count), 2))

entropy_summary <- tibble(
  n_positions    = nrow(df),
  pct_conserved  = mean(df$Group == "Conserved", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  pct_high       = mean(df$Group == "High", na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  entropy_min    = min(df$Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
  entropy_median = median(df$Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
  entropy_mean   = mean(df$Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
  entropy_max    = max(df$Entropy, na.rm = TRUE)
)

out_summary <- file.path(cons_dir, "Entropy_consensus_group_summary.xlsx")
write_xlsx(list("Group_Counts" = group_counts,
                "Entropy_Summary" = entropy_summary),
           out_summary)
message("✔ Summary exported: ", out_summary)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# INTER-GENOTYPE using Entropy_consensus_with_groups
# Saves everything into: .../Consensos/Resultados_Inter/{figures,tables}
# (version avoiding conflicts with IRanges::slice)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(writexl); library(stringr); library(zoo); library(purrr)
})

# ---------- PATHS ----------
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"
cons_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Consensos")
in_path  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx")  # <-- adjust if .csv

results_subdir <- "Resultados_Inter"
out_dir  <- file.path(cons_dir, results_subdir)
fig_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------- 1) READ & CLEAN ----------
df <- readxl::read_excel(in_path)
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

if (!"Position" %in% names(df)) {
  pos <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "^pos")]
  if (length(pos)==1) names(df)[names(df)==pos] <- "Position"
}
if (!"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
  ent <- names(df)[stringr::str_detect(tolower(names(df)), "entropy")]
  if (length(ent)==1) names(df)[names(df)==ent] <- "Entropy"
}
if (!all(c("Gen","Group") %in% names(df))) stop("Missing Gen and/or Group columns.")

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Position = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Position)),
    Entropy  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE))),
    Gen      = as.character(Gen),
    Group    = factor(Group, levels = c("Conserved","Medium","High"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Position), !is.na(Entropy)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Position)

writexl::write_xlsx(df, file.path(tab_dir, "inter_consensus_ORDERED.xlsx"))

# ---------- 2) SUMMARY TABLES ----------
summary_global <- tibble::tibble(
  n_positions    = nrow(df),
  pct_conserved  = mean(df$Group=="Conserved")*100,
  pct_high       = mean(df$Group=="High")*100,
  entropy_min    = min(df$Entropy),
  entropy_median = median(df$Entropy),
  entropy_mean   = mean(df$Entropy),
  entropy_max    = max(df$Entropy)
)

class_counts <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(Group, name = "Count") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Percent = round(100*Count/sum(Count), 2))

gene_stats <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gen), Gen!="") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n        = dplyr::n(),
    H_mean   = mean(Entropy),
    H_median = median(Entropy),
    H_IQR    = IQR(Entropy),
    pct_high = mean(Group=="High")*100,
    pct_cons = mean(Group=="Conserved")*100,
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gen)

writexl::write_xlsx(list(
  "Summary_global" = summary_global,
  "Class_counts"   = class_counts,
  "Gene_stats"     = gene_stats
), file.path(tab_dir, "inter_consensus_summary_tables.xlsx"))

# ---------- 3) BASIC FIGURES ----------
png(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_hist_entropy.png"), width=7, height=5, units="in", res=300)
op <- par(cex.main=1.5, cex.lab=1.3, cex.axis=1.1, mgp=c(2.2,0.7,0))
hist(df$Entropy, breaks=seq(0,1,by=0.1),
     main="Inter-genotype entropy distribution",
     xlab="Shannon Entropy", col="lightblue",
     xlim=c(0,1), xaxt="n", freq=TRUE)
axis(side=1, at=seq(0,1,by=0.1))
par(op); dev.off()

p_profile <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(Position, Entropy, color=Group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size=.6, alpha=.8) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept=c(0.1,0.5), linetype="dashed") +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Inter-genotype entropy across MSA columns",
       x="MSA column (Position)", y="Shannon Entropy", color="Class") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust=.5, face="bold"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_profile_points.png"), p_profile, width=10, height=5.5, dpi=300)

k <- 51
df_roll <- df %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Entropy_smooth = zoo::rollapply(Entropy, k, mean, align="center", fill=NA))
p_roll <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_roll, ggplot2::aes(Position, Entropy_smooth)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(title=paste0("Rolling mean of entropy (k=",k,")"),
       x="MSA column (Position)", y="Rolling mean entropy") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust=.5, face="bold"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_rolling_mean.png"), p_roll, width=10, height=5.5, dpi=300)

# ---------- 4) CONTIGUOUS HOTSPOTS (High > 0.5) ----------
high_blocks <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group=="High") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(d = c(NA, diff(Position)),
                grp = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(d) | d!=1, 1, 0))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(grp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(start=min(Position), end=max(Position),
                   length=end-start+1, peak=max(Entropy), .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(length), dplyr::desc(peak))

writexl::write_xlsx(high_blocks, file.path(tab_dir, "inter_high_blocks.xlsx"))

if (nrow(high_blocks) > 0) {
  p_rect <- ggplot2::ggplot(high_blocks, ggplot2::aes(xmin=start, xmax=end, ymin=0, ymax=1)) +
    ggplot2::geom_rect(fill="tomato", alpha=.6) +

         x="MSA column (Position)", y=NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank())
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_high_blocks_rect.png"), p_rect, width=10, height=2.8, dpi=300)
}

# ---------- 5) BY GENE ----------
df_gen <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gen), Gen!="")

p_violin <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_gen, ggplot2::aes(Gen, Entropy)) +
  ggplot2::geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width=.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill="white") +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Inter-genotype entropy by gene",
       x="Gene", y="Shannon Entropy (0–1)") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust=.5, face="bold"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_violin_by_gene.png"), p_violin, width=9, height=5.5, dpi=300)

class_by_gene <- df_gen %>%
  dplyr::count(Gen, Group) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = n/sum(n)*100) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
writexl::write_xlsx(class_by_gene, file.path(tab_dir, "inter_class_composition_by_gene.xlsx"))

p_stack <- ggplot2::ggplot(class_by_gene, ggplot2::aes(Gen, pct, fill=Group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Class composition by gene (inter-genotype)",
       x="Gene", y="% of positions") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust=.5, face="bold"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_class_composition_by_gene.png"), p_stack, width=9, height=5.5, dpi=300)

# ---------- 6) RELATIVE POSITION WITHIN GENE ----------
df_rel <- df_gen %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gen, Position) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gap = c(NA, diff(Position)),
                seg = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(gap) | gap!=1, 1, 0))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen, seg) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pos_min = min(Position), pos_max = max(Position),
                pos_rel = (Position - pos_min)/pmax(1, pos_max - pos_min)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

df_rel_bin <- df_rel %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin = cut(pos_rel, breaks = seq(0,1,by=0.02), include.lowest=TRUE, right=FALSE)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen, bin) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(H_mean = mean(Entropy), .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(bin_mid = as.numeric(sub("\\[(.*),(.*)\\)", "\\1", as.character(bin))) + 0.01)

writexl::write_xlsx(df_rel_bin, file.path(tab_dir, "inter_entropy_relative_position_by_gene.xlsx"))

p_rel <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_rel_bin, ggplot2::aes(bin_mid, H_mean, color=Gen)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(title="Inter-genotype entropy vs relative position within gene",
       x="Relative position (0–1)", y="Mean Shannon Entropy") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust=.5, face="bold"))
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "inter_entropy_vs_relative_position.png"), p_rel, width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# ---------- 7) SLIDING WINDOWS ----------
win_size <- 150; step <- 25
starts <- seq(min(df$Position), max(df$Position) - win_size + 1, by = step)

win_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(starts, function(s){
  e <- s + win_size - 1
  w <- df %>% dplyr::filter(Position >= s, Position <= e)
  if (nrow(w) < win_size * 0.8) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    start   = s, end = e,
    H_mean  = mean(w$Entropy),
    H_median= median(w$Entropy),
    pct_cons= mean(w$Group=="Conserved")*100,
    pct_high= mean(w$Group=="High")*100,
    gene_mode = {
      gm <- w %>% dplyr::count(Gen, name="n") %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% dplyr::pull(Gen)
      if (length(gm)==0) NA_character_ else gm
    }
  )
})

pan_candidates <- win_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(H_mean <= 0.10, pct_cons >= 90) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(H_mean, dplyr::desc(pct_cons))

var_candidates <- win_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(H_mean >= 0.40, pct_high >= 30) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(H_mean), dplyr::desc(pct_high))

writexl::write_xlsx(list(
  "Windows_all"         = win_tbl,
  "Pan_candidates"      = pan_candidates,
  "Variable_candidates" = var_candidates
), file.path(tab_dir, sprintf("inter_windows_win%d_step%d.xlsx", win_size, step)))

message("Done! Everything was saved to: ", out_dir)
```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# Which genes are more conserved / more variable?
# Main metric: mean entropy per gene (0–1)
# Input:  .../Consensos/Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx
# Outputs:
#   - Table : .../Consensos/Resultados_Inter/tables/gene_conservation_summary.xlsx
#   - Figure: .../Consensos/Resultados_Inter/figures/gene_conservation_lollipop.png
# ======================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(stringr)
  library(writexl); library(forcats); library(scales)
})

# Paths
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"
cons_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Consensos")
in_path  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx")

out_dir  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Resultados_Inter")
fig_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1) Read & clean
df <- read_excel(in_path)
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

if (!"Gen" %in% names(df) || !"Entropy" %in% names(df)) {
  stop("The file must contain 'Gen' and 'Entropy' columns.")
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Gen     = as.character(Gen),
    Entropy = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gen), Gen != "", !is.na(Entropy))

# 2) Per-gene summary
gene_sum <- df %>%
  group_by(Gen) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean_entropy   = mean(Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_entropy = median(Entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_conserved  = mean(Entropy == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_high       = mean(Entropy > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_entropy) %>%
  mutate(
    Gen = fct_reorder(Gen, mean_entropy),            # ordering for the plot
    label = paste0("mean=", round(mean_entropy, 3),
                   " | %High=", round(pct_high, 1), "%")
  )

# Export summary table
write_xlsx(gene_sum, file.path(tab_dir, "gene_conservation_summary.xlsx"))

# 3) Plot: Lollipop (0–1)
p <- ggplot(gene_sum, aes(x = mean_entropy, y = Gen)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = mean_entropy, y = Gen, yend = Gen),
               linewidth = 1, color = "grey75") +
  geom_point(aes(color = mean_entropy), size = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), name = "Mean entropy",
                        option = "D", oob = squish) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Conservation vs variability by gene (inter-genotype)",
    subtitle = "Lower mean entropy → more conserved | Higher → more variable",
    x = "Mean Shannon entropy (0–1)",
    y = "Gene"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max(1, max(gene_sum$mean_entropy, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Save figure
out_png <- file.path(fig_dir, "gene_conservation_lollipop.png")
ggsave(out_png, p, width = 9.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)

message("✔ Table:  ", file.path(tab_dir, "gene_conservation_summary.xlsx"))
message("✔ Plot:   ", out_png)

```

```{r}
# ======================================================
# INTER-GENOTYPE — Per-GENE summary with 95% CI (bootstrap) + Heatmaps
# Inputs:
#   C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos/Consensos/Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx
# Outputs:
#   - tables/gene_conservation_summary_with_CI.xlsx
#   - tables/gene_metrics_table.xlsx
#   - figures/gene_conservation_lollipop_CI.png
#   - figures/heatmap_gene_metrics_RAW.png
#   - figures/heatmap_gene_metrics_NORMALIZED.png
# ======================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl);  library(dplyr);   library(tidyr);   library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr); library(writexl); library(forcats); library(scales)
  library(purrr)
})

# ---------- PATHS ----------
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos"
cons_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Consensos")
in_path  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Entropy_consensus_with_groups.xlsx")

out_dir  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Resultados_Inter")
fig_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
tab_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------- 1) READ & CLEAN ----------
df <- readxl::read_excel(in_path)
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))

if (!all(c("Gen","Entropy") %in% names(df))) {
  stop("The file must contain 'Gen' and 'Entropy' columns.")
}

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gen     = as.character(Gen),
    Entropy = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE)))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gen), Gen != "", !is.na(Entropy))

# ---------- 2) BOOTSTRAP FUNCTION (95% CI FOR THE MEAN) ----------
boot_mean_ci <- function(x, B = 2000L, conf = 0.95){
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(c(mean = mean(x), lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_))
  set.seed(123)  # reproducible
  m <- replicate(B, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE)), simplify = TRUE)
  q <- stats::quantile(m, probs = c((1-conf)/2, 1-(1-conf)/2), na.rm = TRUE)
  c(mean = mean(x), lo = as.numeric(q[1]), hi = as.numeric(q[2]))
}

# ---------- 3) PER-GENE SUMMARY + 95% CI ----------
gene_sum <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gen) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n              = dplyr::n(),
    vals           = list(Entropy),              # per-gene values (list column)
    mean_entropy   = mean(Entropy),
    median_entropy = median(Entropy),
    IQR_entropy    = IQR(Entropy),
    pct_conserved  = mean(Entropy == 0)  * 100,
    pct_high       = mean(Entropy > 0.5) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ci        = purrr::map(vals, boot_mean_ci),
    mean_boot = purrr::map_dbl(ci, ~ .x[["mean"]]),
    lo        = purrr::map_dbl(ci, ~ .x[["lo"]]),
    hi        = purrr::map_dbl(ci, ~ .x[["hi"]])
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-vals, -ci) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean_boot) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gen   = forcats::fct_reorder(Gen, mean_boot),
    label = paste0("mean=", round(mean_boot, 3),
                   " | %High=", round(pct_high, 1), "%")
  )

# Export table with CI
writexl::write_xlsx(gene_sum, file.path(tab_dir, "gene_conservation_summary_with_CI.xlsx"))

# ---------- 4) LOLLIPOP PLOT WITH 95% CI ----------
p_lolli <- ggplot2::ggplot(gene_sum, ggplot2::aes(x = mean_boot, y = Gen)) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = 0, xend = mean_boot, y = Gen, yend = Gen),
                        linewidth = 1, color = "grey80") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(ggplot2::aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi),
                          height = 0.15, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = mean_boot), size = 4) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Mean entropy",
                                 limits = c(0,1), oob = scales::squish) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title    = "Conservation vs variability by gene (inter-genotype) — 95% CI",
    subtitle = "Lower mean entropy → more conserved | Higher → more variable",
    x = "Mean Shannon entropy (0–1)",
    y = "Gene"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 3) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, max(1, max(gene_sum$hi, na.rm=TRUE) * 1.05))) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
                 legend.position = "right")

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "gene_conservation_lollipop_CI.png"),
                p_lolli, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ---------- 5) HEATMAPS OF PER-GENE METRICS ----------
# Wide table of metrics
metrics <- gene_sum %>%
  dplyr::select(Gen, n, mean_entropy, median_entropy, IQR_entropy, pct_conserved, pct_high)

writexl::write_xlsx(metrics, file.path(tab_dir, "gene_metrics_table.xlsx"))

# === FIXED GENE ORDER (more conserved → more variable) ===
# Use lollipop order (increasing mean_boot)
order_gen <- gene_sum %>%
  dplyr::arrange(mean_boot) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Gen) %>%
  as.character()

# Long format for heatmaps (apply fixed levels)
metrics_long <- metrics %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(mean_entropy, median_entropy, IQR_entropy, pct_conserved, pct_high),
    names_to  = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric = factor(metric,
                    levels = c("mean_entropy","median_entropy","IQR_entropy","pct_conserved","pct_high"),
                    labels = c("Mean H","Median H","IQR H","% Conserved","% High")),
    Gen = factor(Gen, levels = order_gen)
  )

# (A) RAW heatmap (real values)
p_raw <- ggplot2::ggplot(metrics_long, ggplot2::aes(x = metric, y = Gen, fill = value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Value",
                                guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(60, "pt"))) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Gene metrics (inter-genotype) — RAW values",
                x = "Metric", y = "Gene") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
                 axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
                 axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
                 panel.grid = element_blank())

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "heatmap_gene_metrics_RAW.png"),
                p_raw, width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

# (B) NORMALIZED heatmap (0–1 per metric) with raw labels
metrics_norm <- metrics_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    value_norm = scales::rescale(value, to = c(0,1),
                                 from = range(value, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

p_norm <- ggplot2::ggplot(metrics_norm, ggplot2::aes(x = metric, y = Gen, fill = value_norm)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Scaled (0–1)", limits = c(0,1)) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(metric %in% c("% Conserved","% High"),
                                paste0(round(value,1), "%"),
                                round(value,3))),
    size = 3, color = "white"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Gene metrics (inter-genotype) — normalized 0–1 (labels show raw)",
                x = "Metric", y = "Gene") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = .5, face = "bold"),
                 axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
                 axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
                 panel.grid = element_blank())

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "heatmap_gene_metrics_NORMALIZED.png"),
                p_norm, width = 8.2, height = 7, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# ===================== Phylogeny using genotype consensus sequences =====================
# ================================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Biostrings)
  library(msa)        # alignment (ClustalOmega or MUSCLE)
  library(ape)        # DNAbin, write.dna, read.dna, nj, etc.
  library(phangorn)   # phyDat, dist.ml, pml, modelTest, bootstrap
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# === Paths ===
cons_dir <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/Todos/Consensos"
out_dir  <- file.path(cons_dir, "Phylogeny")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# === 1) Find and read consensus FASTA files ===
pat <- "(?i)^Consensus_[0-9]+\\.(fasta|fa|fna)$"
fns <- list.files(cons_dir, pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)
if (length(fns) == 0) stop("No files like 'Consensus_X.fasta' were found in: ", cons_dir)

sets <- lapply(fns, readDNAStringSet)
dna  <- do.call(c, sets)

# Rename tips as "HPV <X>" based on file name
tip_from_file <- function(fp) paste0("HPV ", str_extract(basename(fp), "(?<=Consensus_)\\d+"))
if (length(dna) == length(fns)) names(dna) <- vapply(fns, tip_from_file, character(1))

# Save combined FASTA (traceability)
combined_fa <- file.path(out_dir, "Combined_Consensus.fasta")
writeXStringSet(dna, filepath = combined_fa)

# === 2) Align with msa (ClustalOmega recommended; MUSCLE as alternative) ===
aln_msa <- msa::msaClustalOmega(dna)   # alternative: aln_msa <- msa::msaMuscle(dna)

# === 3) Save the MSA as FASTA (reliable via DNAbin) and create a DNA phyDat ===
aln_dnabin <- msa::msaConvert(aln_msa, type = "ape::DNAbin")
msa_fa <- file.path(out_dir, "Consensus_Aligned.fasta")
ape::write.dna(aln_dnabin, file = msa_fa, format = "fasta", nbcol = -1, colsep = "")

# For ML (phangorn), enforce DNA type explicitly:
phy <- phangorn::phyDat(aln_dnabin, type = "DNA")

# === 4) Neighbor-Joining tree with TN93 distances (APE) ===
dist_tn93 <- ape::dist.dna(aln_dnabin, model = "TN93", pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
tree_nj   <- ape::nj(dist_tn93)
ape::write.tree(tree_nj, file.path(out_dir, "HPV_genotypes_NJ_TN93.newick"))

# === 5) Maximum Likelihood (ML) tree with model selection (AICc) + bootstrap ===
fit0 <- phangorn::pml(tree_nj, data = phy)

# --- Robust model selection ---
mt <- phangorn::modelTest(
  fit0,
  model = c("JC","K80","F81","HKY","GTR"),
  G = TRUE, I = TRUE, k = 4
)
stopifnot(nrow(mt) > 0)
mt <- as.data.frame(mt)
has_AICc <- "AICc" %in% names(mt)
best <- mt[order(mt[[ if (has_AICc) "AICc" else "AIC" ]]), ][1, , drop = FALSE]

# NOTE: column is "Model" (capital M)
model_str <- as.character(best$Model)
message("Best model by AICc: ", model_str)

# Parse +G and +I, and extract base model
use_gamma  <- grepl("\\+G", model_str)
use_inv    <- grepl("\\+I", model_str)
k_val      <- if (use_gamma) 4 else 1
base_model <- sub("\\+.*$", "", model_str)  # e.g., "GTR+G+I" -> "GTR"
if (!nzchar(base_model)) {
  warning("Empty model from modelTest; using HKY by default.")
  base_model <- "HKY"; use_gamma <- TRUE; use_inv <- FALSE; k_val <- 4
}

# --- ML optimization ---
fit_ml <- phangorn::optim.pml(
  fit0,
  model         = base_model,
  optNni        = TRUE,
  optGamma      = use_gamma,
  optInv        = use_inv,
  k             = k_val,
  rearrangement = "stochastic"
)

# --- ML bootstrap (adjust 'bs' as needed: 300–1000) ---
set.seed(123)
bs_ml <- phangorn::bootstrap.pml(fit_ml, bs = 1000, optNni = TRUE)

# Save ML tree
ape::write.tree(fit_ml$tree, file.path(out_dir, "HPV_genotypes_ML.newick"))

# === 6) Plot with bootstrap supports (≥50%) ===
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "HPV_genotypes_ML_bootstrap.pdf"), width = 7.5, height = 10)
plot(phangorn::plotBS(fit_ml$tree, bs_ml, p = 50), cex = 0.8)
title("HPV genotypes – ML tree (bootstrap %)")
dev.off()

png(file.path(out_dir, "HPV_genotypes_ML_bootstrap.png"), width = 1900, height = 2600, res = 250)
plot(phangorn::plotBS(fit_ml$tree, bs_ml, p = 50), cex = 0.8)
title("HPV genotypes – ML tree (bootstrap %)")
dev.off()

message("Done. Files were created in: ", out_dir)
```
